extracted.name: Rock's T-Bone Steaks
extracted.description: Grill a T-bone steak with a simple blend of seasonings, including paprika, garlic, coriander, and turmeric, to make it taste fantastic and flavorful.
ingredient_lines: 0.75 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste
0.75 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
0.75 teaspoon ground coriander, or to taste
0.75 teaspoon ground turmeric, or to taste
4 (16 ounce) t-bone steaks, at room temperature
instruction_lines: Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Stir together salt, paprika, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, coriander, and turmeric in a small bowl.
Rub seasoning over steaks on all sides.

Cook steaks on the preheated grill to the desired degree of doneness, 3 to 3 1/2 minutes per side for medium-rare. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of each steak should read 130 degrees F (54 degrees C).
